od.rule: p50 origin to its nearest safe node
p50 origin to the reachable safe node at the 90th percentile of shortest free-flow time
most people among origins whose shortest path to the nearest safe node crosses a bridge cell
most people among origins whose shortest path to the nearest safe node crosses a low-water crossing cell
p10 origin to the reachable safe node farthest by shortest free-flow time

encoding.frames: uint16-le [F, T] per scenario (<key>_n.bin): vehicles = value x scale over the scenario's cells (T, sorted); frame i is i minutes after the departure (frame 0 the initial state), except the last frame of a run that stopped between two minutes, which is at the run's end; frame_t gives every frame's time after the departure (s), and minute_t the time of each entry of the minute series
encoding.water_roads: uint8 = round(depth_m / 0.02) per hourly row x cell, capped at 5.1 m
encoding.closed_wet: bits (little-endian) per minute frame x cell: road depth >= closure_m, frame i at the wet departure + i min (the depth the CTM uses then)
encoding.dots: per dot: cells entered (path) and the times (s after the departure, 0.1 s) of its release and of each cell entry, then its arrival

menu_source: docs/reports/ctm_benchmarks.json B.menu (recomputed by menu.select and asserted equal)

dry_runs.stop: when the queue and the vehicles on non-held cells are <= 1e-12 x V

wet_note: wet: time-varying routing; the calculated shares (B1) exist only for fixed routing, so there is no expected-route layer and no share check
a14_note: A14: no road cell at its node; the node is safe, so its vehicles arrive at once
dots_rule: max over CTM steps (the end of every step, choices log row 43) |dots arrived / M - CTM arrived / V| <= 0.05 + 1 / (2M) (choices log row 33; the spec's 0.05 is recorded as pass_spec)
dots_M_rule: post hoc (ctm-docs-rulings.md R13, choices log row 42): a fixed 200 dots per run, each standing for V / 200 vehicles

dots_preregistered.note: pre-registered rule, run before ctm-docs-rulings.md R13; the export was not published (one run failed)
